info.title: Represent Officials API
info.description: This API provides access to information about elected officials and electoral districts in Canada. Users can find representatives based on postal codes or geographical coordinates, retrieve boundary sets, and explore details about elections and candidates.

get.summary: Find representatives and boundaries by postal code
get.description: Returns representatives and boundaries for a given postal code. Postal code must be in uppercase with no spaces. Results include both centroid-based and concordance-based matches.

parameters.name: postalCode
parameters.description: Canadian postal code in uppercase with no spaces (e.g., L5G4L3)

parameters.name: sets
parameters.description: Limit results to specific boundary sets (comma-separated)

boundaries_centroid.description: Boundaries containing the postal code's centroid

boundaries_concordance.description: Boundaries linked to postal code via official data

get.description: Returns a paginated list of boundary sets. A boundary set is a group of electoral districts.
Returns details about a specific boundary set.
Returns a paginated list of boundaries. Can be filtered by various criteria including geospatial queries.

parameters.name: touches
parameters.description: Find boundaries that touch the specified boundary

parameters.name: intersects
parameters.description: Find boundaries that intersect the specified boundary

get.summary: Get boundaries from a boundary set
get.description: Returns boundaries from a specific boundary set.
Returns details about a specific boundary.

get.summary: Get simplified shapes for all boundaries in a set
get.description: Returns simplified geometric shapes for all boundaries in the set (tolerance 0.002). Default format is GeoJSON.

get.summary: Get original shapes for all boundaries in a set
get.description: Returns original geometric shapes for all boundaries in the set. Default format is GeoJSON.

get.summary: Get centroids for all boundaries in a set
get.description: Returns centroid points for all boundaries in the set. Default format is GeoJSON.
Returns the simplified geometric shape for a specific boundary.
Returns the original geometric shape for a specific boundary.
Returns the centroid point for a specific boundary.
Returns all representatives for a specific boundary.
Returns a paginated list of representative sets. A representative set is a group of elected officials.
Returns details about a specific representative set.
Returns a paginated list of representatives. Can be filtered by various criteria including geospatial queries.

parameters.name: elected_office
parameters.description: Filter by elected office (e.g., MP, MLA, Mayor, Councillor)

get.summary: Get representatives from a representative set
get.description: Returns representatives from a specific representative set.
Returns a paginated list of elections.
Returns a paginated list of electoral candidates. Candidate lists may be incomplete or incorrect.

elected_office.description: Type of office (e.g., MP, MLA, Mayor, Councillor, Alderman)

source_url.description: URL where the data is scraped from

url.description: Representative's page on official legislature site

personal_url.description: Personal website not on official legislature site

extra.description: Additional data not covered by standard fields

tags.description: Find representatives and boundaries by postal code

tags.name: Shapes
